body.query: What is the difference in the annual average consumption of the customers with the least amount of consumption paid in CZK for 2013 between SME and LAM, LAM and KAM, and KAM and SME?

raw_response.sql:
WITH czk_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id, segment
  FROM customers
  WHERE currency = 'CZK'
),
monthly_2013 AS (
  SELECT ym.customer_id, ym.consumption
  FROM yearmonth ym
  INNER JOIN czk_customers cc ON cc.customer_id = ym.customer_id
  WHERE ym.date LIKE '2013%'
),
customer_average AS (
  SELECT cc.segment,
         m.customer_id,
         AVG(m.consumption) AS avg_consumption_2013
  FROM monthly_2013 m
  INNER JOIN czk_customers cc ON cc.customer_id = m.customer_id
  GROUP BY cc.segment, m.customer_id
),
segment_least AS (
  SELECT segment, MIN(avg_consumption_2013) AS least_avg_consumption
  FROM customer_average
  GROUP BY segment
),
segment_values AS (
  SELECT MAX(least_avg_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') AS sme_value,
         MAX(least_avg_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS lam_value,
         MAX(least_avg_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS kam_value
  FROM segment_least
)
SELECT 'SME - LAM' AS comparison, sme_value - lam_value AS consumption_difference
FROM segment_values
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LAM - KAM' AS comparison, lam_value - kam_value AS consumption_difference
FROM segment_values
UNION ALL
SELECT 'KAM - SME' AS comparison, kam_value - sme_value AS consumption_difference
FROM segment_values
ORDER BY 1

WITH czk_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id, segment
  FROM customers
  WHERE currency = 'CZK'
),
monthly_2013 AS (
  SELECT ym.customer_id, ym.consumption
  FROM yearmonth ym
  INNER JOIN czk_customers cc ON cc.customer_id = ym.customer_id
  WHERE ym.date LIKE '2013%'
),
customer_average AS (
  SELECT cc.segment,
         m.customer_id,
         AVG(m.consumption) AS avg_consumption_2013
  FROM monthly_2013 m
  INNER JOIN czk_customers cc ON cc.customer_id = m.customer_id
  GROUP BY cc.segment, m.customer_id
),
segment_least AS (
  SELECT segment, MIN(avg_consumption_2013) AS least_avg_consumption
  FROM customer_average
  GROUP BY segment
),
segment_values AS (
  SELECT MAX(least_avg_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') AS sme_value,
         MAX(least_avg_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS lam_value,
         MAX(least_avg_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS kam_value
  FROM segment_least
)
SELECT 'SME - LAM' AS comparison, sme_value - lam_value AS consumption_difference
FROM segment_values
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LAM - KAM' AS comparison, lam_value - kam_value AS consumption_difference
FROM segment_values
UNION ALL
SELECT 'KAM - SME' AS comparison, kam_value - sme_value AS consumption_difference
FROM segment_values
ORDER BY 1

payload.sql:
WITH czk_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id, segment
  FROM customers
  WHERE currency = 'CZK'
),
monthly_2013 AS (
  SELECT ym.customer_id, ym.consumption
  FROM yearmonth ym
  INNER JOIN czk_customers cc ON cc.customer_id = ym.customer_id
  WHERE ym.date LIKE '2013%'
),
customer_average AS (
  SELECT cc.segment,
         m.customer_id,
         AVG(m.consumption) AS avg_consumption_2013
  FROM monthly_2013 m
  INNER JOIN czk_customers cc ON cc.customer_id = m.customer_id
  GROUP BY cc.segment, m.customer_id
),
segment_least AS (
  SELECT segment, MIN(avg_consumption_2013) AS least_avg_consumption
  FROM customer_average
  GROUP BY segment
),
segment_values AS (
  SELECT MAX(least_avg_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'SME') AS sme_value,
         MAX(least_avg_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'LAM') AS lam_value,
         MAX(least_avg_consumption) FILTER (WHERE segment = 'KAM') AS kam_value
  FROM segment_least
)
SELECT 'SME - LAM' AS comparison, sme_value - lam_value AS consumption_difference
FROM segment_values
UNION ALL
SELECT 'LAM - KAM' AS comparison, lam_value - kam_value AS consumption_difference
FROM segment_values
UNION ALL
SELECT 'KAM - SME' AS comparison, kam_value - sme_value AS consumption_difference
FROM segment_values
ORDER BY 1
